name: clear billing
purpose: A plain billing problem. Catches a model that cannot do the easy case, and checks that a wrong charge is high urgency.
message: I was charged twice for my subscription this month.

name: clear technical
purpose: A plain technical problem where the customer is blocked. Checks category and that being locked out is high urgency.
message: The app crashes every time I log in, I can't use it at all.

name: clear sales
purpose: A plain pre-purchase question. Urgency is a judgment call here, so it is not checked.
message: Do you offer a discount for student teams of 10?

name: ambiguous: upgrade button broken
purpose: Fits two categories: the customer wants to buy (sales) and something is broken (technical). Either passes. Catches a model that answers unknown when it has to choose.
message: I want to upgrade to Pro but the upgrade button gives an error.

name: not a support request
purpose: Off-topic. Must be unknown. Catches a model that forces every message into a real category.
message: What's a good pizza place near campus?
